title: What Pet Adoption Guide Is and Why It Matters

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Pet Adoption Guide
summary: Start pet adoption guide this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Assess lifestyle: time, space, budget, energy
2. Research breeds/species honestly
3. Visit shelters; meet multiple animals
4. Ask about history, health, behavior
5. Prepare home before pickup

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.
facts: Assess lifestyle: time, space, budget, energy
